
### DNS messages (1) 


* client sends query to server
* server responds with response 
<hr class="vspace" />
* response and query have same format 

   * but different fields set/used



### DNS message 

![](/dns/texfig/query-answer-dns-message.figure-1.svg){fig-alt="DNS message consisting of: 16-bit ID, 1-bit QR, 4-bit opcode, 1-bit fields AA, TC, RD, RA, constant 0, AD, CD; 4-bit RCODE; 16-bit QDCOUNT (1 or 0); ANCOUNT; NSCOUNT; ARCOUNT; then QDCOUNT questions, and ANCOUNT+NSCOUNT+ARCOUNT RRs"}

### DNS message (flags)

![](/dns/texfig/query-answer-dns-message.figure-2.svg){fig-alt="same figure as previous slide, but 1-bit fields near beginning are highlighted."}

::: {.myoverbox .vlow}

*  'flags'
    *  QR = 0 if query, 1 if response 
    *  AA = 1 if authoritative 
    *  TC = 1 if truncated (packet size limit) 
    *  RD = 1 if query wants recursion (contact other servers) 
    *  RA = 1 if server supports recursion
*  DNSSEC (PKI for DNS) additions: 
    *  AD = 1 if verified cryptographically (`authentic data') 
    *  CD = 1 if no cryptographic check requested (`checking disabled') 

:::

### DNS message (opcode)

![](/dns/texfig/query-answer-dns-message.figure-3.svg){fig-alt="same figure as previous slide, but 4-bit opcode field is highlighted."}

::: {.myoverbox .vlow}

*  opcode
*  0 for query
*  also some other operations (less common)

:::

### DNS message (rcode)

![](/dns/texfig/query-answer-dns-message.figure-3.svg){fig-alt="same figure as previous slide, but 4-bit RCODE field is highlighted."}

::: {.myoverbox .vlow}

response code, 0 for no error

:::


### response with no answer+authority+additional  {.smaller}


```
$ dig @nom.virginia.edu cs.virginia.edu ns +noedns
...
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 33036
;; flags: qr rd; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1, ADDITIONAL: 1
;; WARNING: recursion requested but not available

;; QUESTION SECTION:
;cs.virginia.edu.               IN      NS

;; AUTHORITY SECTION:
cs.virginia.edu.        3600    IN      NS      coresrv01a.cs.virginia.edu.

;; ADDITIONAL SECTION:
coresrv01a.cs.virginia.edu. 3600 IN     A       128.143.67.64

```


### response with 2 answers  {.smaller}


```
$ dig @coresrv01a.cs.virginia.edu cs.virginia.edu a +noedns
...
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 5084
;; flags: qr aa rd; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 2, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 0
;; WARNING: recursion requested but not available

;; QUESTION SECTION:
;cs.virginia.edu.               IN      A

;; ANSWER SECTION:
cs.Virginia.EDU.        172800  IN      A       128.143.67.8
cs.Virginia.EDU.        172800  IN      A       128.143.67.64

```


### response with CNAME answer to A query  {.smaller}


```
$ dig @nom.virginia.edu canvas.its.virginia.edu +noedns
...
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 32583
;; flags: qr aa rd; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 1, AUTHORITY: 0, ADDITIONAL: 0
;; WARNING: recursion requested but not available

;; QUESTION SECTION:
;canvas.its.virginia.edu.       IN      A

;; ANSWER SECTION:
canvas.its.virginia.edu. 3600   IN      CNAME   universityofvirginia-vanity.instructure.com.

```


### response  with CNAME chain in answers + authority  {.smaller}


```
$ dig @ns-1354.awsdns-41.org. universityofvirignia-vanity.instructure.com. +noedns
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: NOERROR, id: 60997
;; flags: qr aa rd; QUERY: 1, ANSWER: 2, AUTHORITY: 4, ADDITIONAL: 0
;; WARNING: recursion requested but not available

;; QUESTION SECTION:
;universityofvirignia-vanity.instructure.com. IN        A

;; ANSWER SECTION:
universityofvirignia-vanity.instructure.com. 300 IN CNAME cluster1.instructure.com.
cluster1.instructure.com. 900   IN      CNAME   canvas-iad-prod-c1-1262762608.us-east-1.elb.amazonaws.com.

;; AUTHORITY SECTION:
instructure.com.        172800  IN      NS      ns-1354.awsdns-41.org.
instructure.com.        172800  IN      NS      ns-1799.awsdns-32.co.uk.
instructure.com.        172800  IN      NS      ns-2.awsdns-00.com.
instructure.com.        172800  IN      NS      ns-996.awsdns-60.net.

```


### DNS message  {.smaller}


* header
* 0 or 1 question 

   * domain name + class + type
   * (RR without TTL or value)
   * special type values for ANY, some other things

* ANCOUNT RRs in ‘answer section’: 

   * matches for question domain name + class + type
   * special case: CNAMEs always match; can include CNAMEs of name

* NSCOUNT+ADCOUNT RRs in ‘authority section’ and ‘additional’ section 

   * NS or SOA records (authority); associated A/AAAA records (additional)
